name: Cuddle Quest: Tricksy's Cuddle Crusade
source:
As punishment for her silly hijinx, Tricksy must make friends. Will she achieve her goal in friendship and cuddles?


A cute and funny story about friendship, family, and pony cuddle piles.

[From [url=https://thecrimsondm-vanillia.itch.io/cuddle-quest-tricksys-cuddle-crusade]itch.io[/url]]
